messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — I'm seeing weird retry behavior in the Next.js sample app when running in the Edge runtime; SSR page renders are causing duplicate tokens.
Maria Chen: Repro (short): deploy sample -> hit /chat SSR route -> the server render makes one inference call but we see two token charges in telemetry.
Maria Chen: Minimal repro snippet from the sample's server handler:
```js
// app/pages/api/generate.js (Edge runtime)
export const runtime = 'edge';
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
export default async function handler(req) {
  const res = await client.generate({ model: 'rw-llama-13b', prompt: 'hello' });
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(res));
}
```
Kevin Ortiz: Are you using the browser SDK or the node/js SDK? Edge runtime quirks matter.
Maria Chen: @Kevin using @redwood/inference-js v0.8.2 (installed in the sample). Logs attached show two attempts.
Raj Patel: Can you paste the exact log lines? 429s or network timeouts?
Maria Chen: Logs: 
```
[2026-02-12T14:22:01Z] SDKRetry: attempt=1 status=429 socket_err=false idempotency=null
[2026-02-12T14:22:01Z] EdgeFetch: network error, retrying (fetch polyfill)
[2026-02-12T14:22:02Z] SDKRetry: attempt=2 status=200 idempotency=null
```
Maria Chen: It looks like the fetch polyfill in Edge throws a network error on 429 and the transport layer retries, while the SDK's higher-level retry also retried -> double submit.
Kevin Ortiz: Hmm. That's plausible. We have two retry layers: fetch-level retry (polyfill) + SDK retry policy. Edge runtime historically returns opaque errors for some responses.
Jen Lo: Short-term fix: add an idempotency key in server-side calls or disable SDK auto-retry for SSR handlers.
Raj Patel: Can you confirm disabling SDK retry prevents the double-charge?
Maria Chen: Verified locally: set client config { retry: false } in server handler -> single token charge. Worked.
Kevin Ortiz: I'll draft a patch to add a config option `retryMode: 'none' | 'standard' | 'idempotent'` and have the samples default to idempotent in server runtimes. Will also add logic to set an idempotency header automatically when running in Node/Server runtimes.
Maria Chen: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/2043 (Edge SSR double-submit). Added repro steps and logs.
devex-bot: Issue #2043 created and assigned to @Kevin Ortiz, milestone v0.9.1
Jen Lo: Long-term: we should update the Next.js quickstart docs and the sample template to mention Edge runtime caveats and show an SSR-safe example. Also add a note in the SDK migration guide about default retry semantics.
Kevin Ortiz: WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5124 — adds `retryMode` and auto-idempotency for server contexts. (still draft)
Maria Chen: Thanks — once PR lands I'll update the devex starter to use it and regen the quickstart ZIP.
Raj Patel: Also suggest adding an automated unit test to the sample harness that runs in a Node-like env and asserts only one outbound request is made for a single SSR render.
Jen Lo: Adding a doc TODO in the repo: docs/quickstart/edge-runtime.md — cover ephemeral keys, idempotency, and retry knobs.
Maria Chen: Filed a follow-up: added a short blurb to the starter README in my fork. Will open PR after Kevin's patch merges.
Kevin Ortiz: I'll ping here when PR is ready for review. Thanks for the clear repro + logs, Maria :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: np — happy this was caught before customers hit it in prod.
